# BobGuard Incident Report — INC-001
# Raw (pre-sanitization) | Generated by BobGuard MVP demo

## Summary

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Incident | INC-001 — Billing Pagination: Last Page Silently Dropped |
| Severity | High |
| Status | RESOLVED (post-fix) |
| Component | `app/Invoke-Calculator.ps1` → `Get-TotalPages` |
| Analyst | IBM Bob 2.0 (BobGuard MVP) |

## Diagnosis

IBM Bob analyzed `app/Invoke-Calculator.ps1`, `incidents/INC-001/incident.md`,
`docs/ADR-001-pagination.md`, `docs/runbook-INC-001.md`, and
`incidents/INC-001/logs.md`.

### Root Cause

`Get-TotalPages` at line 40 uses `[int]($Count / $PageSize)` (integer truncation)
instead of `[Math]::Ceiling($Count / $PageSize)`.

When `Count=25, PageSize=10`, the function returns `2` instead of `3`.
Page index 2 (containing 5 records) is never fetched.

### Evidence

- **Source:** `app/Invoke-Calculator.ps1` line 40 — integer cast instead of ceiling.
- **Log:** `incidents/INC-001/logs.md` — `Get-TotalPages result=2`, `total_exported=20`, integrity check FAILED.
- **ADR-001:** Explicitly mandates ceiling division; the implementation violates this ADR.
- **Regression test:** `tests/Invoke-Tests.ps1 -Suite Regression` — confirmed FAIL before fix.

## Fix Applied

```powershell
# app/Invoke-Calculator.ps1 line 40
# Before (bug):
return [int]($Count / $PageSize)
# After (fix):
return [Math]::Ceiling($Count / $PageSize)
```

## Post-Fix Verification

All tests pass after the fix (see Phase 5 results below).
